title: Breaking the Mucin Barrier: A New Affinity Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry Approach
author: Romero-Ruiz, Granados-Rodríguez, et al.

steps.title: Dissect and homogenize mucin
steps.instruction: Weigh 1 g of each soft or hard mucin sample (tumour or control), cut into 1–3 mm fragments and homogenise in 3.5–4.5 ml binding buffer (20 mM Tris, 500 mM NaCl, 1 mM MnCl₂, 1 mM CaCl₂) using ultrasonic pulses.

steps.title: Centrifuge and filter homogenate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenate (conditions as used by the authors) and filter the supernatant through a 0.22 µm syringe filter.

steps.title: Capture glycoproteins on Con A column
steps.instruction: Load 3–4 ml of the filtered extract onto an Äkta Purifier equipped with a HiTrap Con A 4B column (Cytiva). Collect the flow‑through in 0.4 ml fractions that correspond to the maximum absorbance peaks on the two‑dimensional chromatogram.

steps.title: Precipitate and resuspend flow‑through
steps.instruction: Add four volumes of cold acetone to each collected fraction, mix, and incubate on ice to precipitate proteins. Centrifuge, discard supernatant, and resuspend each pellet in 1.5 ml binding buffer (20 mM NaH₂PO₄, 150 mM NaCl).

steps.title: Pool, centrifuge and filter extract
steps.instruction: Combine all resuspended fractions into a single tube, centrifuge to remove debris, and filter the supernatant through a 0.22 µm filter.

steps.title: Deplete albumin and IgG
steps.instruction: Inject 0.5 ml of the filtered extract onto the Äkta Purifier now fitted with a HiTrap Albumin and IgG depletion column (Cytiva). Collect the flow‑through in 0.2 ml fractions that correspond to the maximum absorbance peaks.

steps.title: Precipitate second‑round flow‑through
steps.instruction: Precipitate the collected 0.2 ml fractions with four volumes of cold acetone, centrifuge, and discard supernatant. Use part of the resulting pellet directly for mass‑spectrometry analysis; resuspend the remaining pellet in 100 µl DIGE lysis buffer (0.1 mM urea, 1 M thiourea, 30 mM Tris, 4 % w/v CHAPS) for Western blot or ELISA.

steps.title: Prepare samples for nano‑LC/MS‑MS
steps.instruction: Precipitate all protein samples (if not already precipitated), determine protein concentration, and process them according to the SWATH‑MS protein quantification workflow to generate nano‑LC/MS‑MS data using a SWATH‑MS DIA acquisition method.
